Subject: Post-signature MAP: Activation dossier and canary migration schedule

Hi Elena / Tom —

Congrats again on the signature. Attached is the first draft of the activation dossier embedded into the Mutual Action Plan (MPA_v1.xlsx) and a short evaluation criteria doc (EvaluationCriteria.pdf) that we use for canary validation. This thread's goal is to lock in:

- Canary window (target: one-week window with two low-traffic days)
- Migration sequencing (read-only -> shadow -> cutover)
- Training blocks for ops and support (two 90-min sessions + Q&A)
- Primary roll owner and acceptance gates

Quick asks for you:
1) Confirm your preferred canary window (we've penciled in Jul 13–19).
2) Share the names for the three operational leads who will attend training and the preferred time zone for sessions.
3) Flag any required evidence for security/compliance beyond what's in the Security FAQ — we'll attach a short addendum if needed.

I've also added a suggested timeline in the MPA sheet: week 0 (prep), week 1 (shadow), week 2 (canary), week 3 (go-live & stabilization). All dates are configurable — if you want a condensed two-week cadence we can propose an alternate.

Attachment stubs: MPA_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), EvaluationCriteria.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — feel free to call if you want to walk through it live.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen

Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear draft. Quick responses inline:

- Canary window: Jul 20–26 works better for us (we have a product release the week of Jul 6). Can we aim for a mid-week cutover (Wed Jul 22) so we have a full stabilization period before the following weekend?
- Migration sequencing: agreed on read-only -> shadow -> cutover. Our infra team prefers a brief DB sync window the night before the shadow starts (2am–3am PT).
- Training: names below — prefer two sessions the week of Jul 14 at 10am PT and 1pm PT to cover east/west teams.
  - Elena Morales — Director, Product Ops
  - Tom Baker — Head of Platform
  - Priya Kapoor <pri.kap@apexhealth.com> — Release Manager

Also attaching a security addendum from our side that requests an additional audit log export for the first 30 days post-cutover. See SecurityAddendum.pdf (attachment stub).

If you can update the MPA with the Jul 20 start and the DB sync slot, we can sign off on the timeline and circulate internally.

Best,
Elena

Attachment stubs: SecurityAddendum.pdf

Elena / Tom —

Thanks — noted on Jul 20–26 canary and Wed Jul 22 cutover preference. A couple of operational clarifications from our side:

- DB sync window: the 2am–3am PT window is acceptable. We'll plan for an initial incremental sync (30m) followed by a final cutover sync; target low-traffic tables only for the incremental phase.
- Canary validation: we'll run the evaluation suite in EvaluationCriteria.pdf at +24h and +72h after cutover. If either check fails we automatically roll back to shadow within the first 48h.
- Escalation & rollback owners:
  - Roll forward owner: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai) — handles canary monitoring and acceptance signoff
  - Rollback owner: Lauren Bishop (lauren_bishop@redwood.ai) — handles immediate rollback decisions and communication to your ops

Marissa — please prepare the acceptance checklist (short checklist in the MPA will suffice) and add it to the shared Drive link.

On the training cadence: we'll record the 10am PT session for those who can't attend and circulate the recording + quick reference deck.

—Lauren
